exposure: planned cesarean delivery on the scheduled date
Timing of planned cesarean delivery (before vs. on scheduled date)
planned cesarean delivery before the scheduled date
outcome: Maternal morbidity (surgical complications, postpartum hemorrhage, infection, thrombo-embolism)
Neonatal morbidity (5-min Apgar score < 7, arterial cord blood pH < 7.00, NICU admission)
cohort: 1450 women with singleton pregnancies who underwent planned cesarean deliveries after 36 weeks + 6 days gestation
finding: Planned cesarean deliveries performed before the scheduled date were associated with a higher risk of maternal morbidity compared to those performed on the scheduled date.
mod_finding: Maternal morbidity is higher for planned cesarean deliveries performed before rather than on the scheduled date.
gest_age: 38.7 weeks +/- 0.8 for planned cesarean deliveries before the scheduled date vs 39.2 weeks +/- 0.7 for those performed as scheduled
